claims: Scraped 'hundreds' of competitor ads; each row has hooks, copy, images and funnel
Setup takes under 30 seconds with one prompt
Claude finds 15 competitors and sorts them into direct, adjacent or aspirational
It pulls every ad from every page in the Meta Ad Library, watches every video and image, and tags hook and angle
You can then ask Claude to remake a chosen ad for your own product
how_to_steps: Open Claude Code (or Cowork) and paste the creator's prompt/skill
Claude reads your offer and lists 15 competitors by direct / adjacent / aspirational
Claude opens the Meta Ad Library for each page and pulls all active ads
Each video/image is analysed and tagged (hook, angle, copy, creative, funnel) into a table
Paste an ad library URL and say 'remake this ad for me' to adapt a winner to your offer
on_screen_only: Title card 'I BUILT AN AD SPY AGENT'
Airtable gallery and grid views titled 'Ad Spy Vault' with ad thumbnails and columns for hook/copy

Claude Cowork home: 'What can we tackle together?', model 'Sonnet 5 High', Chat/Cowork toggle, 'Project or folder', suggested tasks 'Polish my notes into one doc', 'Prep tomorrow before I log off', 'Clean up my Desktop'
Meta Ad Library results page with video ads
Claude prompt box: pasted 'https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/...' followed by 'remake this ad for me', with 'Accept edits' and 'Sonnet 5 High' controls
Whiteboard behind creator: 'Ad vault', 'System', 'Static / Video', 'Copy', 'Zapier', 'Done conversation'
End card COMMENT "SKILLS" with a blurred skill-file preview

relevance.why: Competitor ad intelligence for ~$1 is useful whenever Haji runs paid acquisition for an app; relies on a comment-gated skill and the Meta Ad Library's scrapability

implement_score.why: Rebuildable in an afternoon: a skill that uses Apify/Playwright on the Meta Ad Library, a tagging rubric, and output to Airtable/CSV. Only worth it when actively running ads
